description: A text input that filters a listbox (DESIGN.md, Combobox), with the model of the web's: typing filters options and opens the panel below it (menu panel styling) with no option active; a press on the field, or an arrow, opens every option, the chosen one active; arrows move the active option with no wrap, from none down to the first and up to the last; Enter chooses it, or with none active keeps the text, which chooses an option it names (in any case) and otherwise stays with freeText or goes back to the last chosen label; focus leaving does the same. Escape closes the panel, then clears the text, then passes on. loading shows a spinner row instead of the options; an empty list shows a "no results" row; the number of results is announced 500 ms after typing pauses, and again when the options change.

constructors.description: A combobox named label, searching options.

params.name: label
params.description: The accessible name, shown above the field.

params.name: options
params.description: The candidate options; matched by filter against the typed text.

params.name: onSelected
params.description: Called with an option's value when it is chosen.

params.name: filter
params.description: Matches an option against the query; a case-insensitive substring match on ListboxOption.label by default.

params.name: loading
params.description: Shows a loading row instead of the filtered options (an async fetch of them is in flight).

params.name: freeText
params.description: Allows text matching no option to stand as typed; otherwise it reverts once the field loses focus.

params.name: placeholder
params.description: Shown in TsuyaColors.textMuted while the field is empty.

params.name: hint
params.description: Under the field, replaced by error.

params.name: error
params.description: Under the field instead of hint, with the alert glyph; also marks the field invalid in semantics.

params.name: optional
params.description: Appends the optional marker to label.

params.name: required
params.description: Marks the field as required in semantics.

params.name: enabled
params.description: Disables the field: faded, read-only, not focusable.

params.name: controller
params.description: Uncontrolled when null (the field keeps its own).

params.name: focusNode
params.description: The node to track focus with, when the caller manages one.

params.name: autofocus
params.description: Focuses the field as soon as it is built.
